groups.distinction: Pixmap/PixmapRef native image ownership differs borrowed versus owned, while native premultiplied color storage differs PNG unpremultiplied channel interpretation. EncodingError is the exact0.17 dependency owner; encode_png returns bytes versus save_png also commits filesystem I/O.
groups.uses: Actual encode makes a copy, demultiplies channels, configures RGBA8 and propagates native header/data failures. Save propagates encoding and filesystem errors with same native error family; returning captured pixels is not proof bytes reached disk.
groups.disposition: Keep image representation, byte encoding and persistence outcome distinctions; no duplicate PNG error taxonomy or blanket rawbyte wrapper requirement. Native unchecked color constructor sits in explicit conversion kernel, not permission for first-party retained APIs to erase alpha/color role.
groups.acceptance: Application export/capture APIs should bind their actual stage and path to original native error. Preserve alpha conversion and image dimensions, and distinguish capture/encode/write completion without inventing a generic image unit framework. No filesystem save, encode run or dependency changes.

groups.distinction: BufferAsyncError means map failure; RequestDeviceError means adapter device creation; CreateSurfaceError includes HAL/web/raw-handle causes. Native wrapper encapsulates backend configuration and source behavior, not a redundant application role. MapMode is read/write authority, BufferDescriptor native buffer policy.
groups.uses: Native Display reports cause, but source() may return None for web and delegate inner source forcore/rawhandle. Surface raw display/window handles carry explicit lifetime/unsafe ownership rather than fungible IDs. No invented native map subcategories exist in unit BufferAsyncError.
groups.disposition: Keep actual phase-specific native owners and expose meaningful application context without duplicating backend enums or making universal GpuError(String). Do not promise a source chain where backend intentionally has only text. A shared parent error enum may own these distinct native causes rather than flatten them.
groups.acceptance: Actual application buffer readback/device/surface callers pending11 must retain original native errors, command/device/buffer association and actual phase. No device or mapping run, and incomplete constructor tail beyond registered excerpt receives no proof.

limits: Exact pinned registered ranges personally read for11; no other-lens source credit, source edits, tests/checks, native execution, clearance or implementation plan.
